A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new class of estimators, called Importance Weighted Generative Networks, which can learn to sample from a target distribution, given only samples from a different distribution.
we propose an algorithm to learn the target distribution, given a source distribution, and then we can use the learned distribution as the training distribution to train a generative model.
